verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Hatchet has event filters driven by CEL expressions, a documented Webhooks page, and community praise for its trigger-based flows. This points to event-driven triggering as a native capability, but nothing explicitly describes events from apps or queues declaratively triggering workflows. missing for 10: explicit documentation of event-triggered workflow declarations, any evidence of one event fanning out to many functions, details on webhook/queue ingestion as triggers, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a backend developer, events from my app, webhooks, or queues trigger workflows declaratively, and one event can fan out to many functions

citations.quote: Evaluate and debug CEL expressions used in event filters
The flow-based UI with triggers is killer!
the execution path of a multi-step workflow in Hatchet is declared ahead of time
